description: Read this week's Harris Teeter weekly ad (Weekly Specials) at your store, by department: 1 Produce, 2 Breads & Bakery, 3 Deli, 4 Dairy & Chilled Foods, 5 Frozen Foods, 6 Meat - Packaged, 7 Meat - Fresh, 8 Seafood, 9 Breakfast Foods, 10 Meal Makers, 11 Baking Items, 12 Snacks & Sweets, 13 Beverages, 14 Beer & Wine, 15 Household Essentials, 16 Pet Essentials, 17 Health Care Essentials, 18 Beauty Care Essentials. Omit department for every department.

search.description: Only items whose title mentions this, e.g. "chicken".

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands; "raw" returns the upstream payload unprojected. compact returns a projection of the documented fields; "full" returns the API payload minified; "raw" pretty-prints it.

name: ht_get_weekly_ad
